name: Item Wise Sales Report
sql_query:
SELECT
    i.item_code,
    i.item_description,
    c.name                                                        AS category_name,
    b.name                                                        AS brand_name,
    COALESCE(s.invoice_count, 0)                                  AS invoice_count,
    COALESCE(s.sold_qty, 0)                                       AS sold_qty,
    COALESCE(s.gross_value, 0)                                    AS gross_value,
    COALESCE(s.discount, 0)                                       AS discount,
    COALESCE(s.net_sales, 0)                                      AS net_sales,
    COALESCE(r.return_qty, 0)                                     AS return_qty,
    COALESCE(r.return_value, 0)                                   AS return_value,
    COALESCE(s.sold_qty, 0)  - COALESCE(r.return_qty, 0)          AS net_qty,
    COALESCE(s.net_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_value, 0)        AS net_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(s.sold_qty, 0) > 0
            THEN ROUND(s.net_sales / s.sold_qty, 2)
        ELSE 0
    END                                                           AS avg_selling_price
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = i.category_id
LEFT JOIN m_brands   b ON b.id = i.brand_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        d.Item_code                                   AS item_code,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.Invoice_no)                  AS invoice_count,
        SUM(d.QTY)                                    AS sold_qty,
        SUM(d.QTY * d.Unit_price)                     AS gross_value,
        SUM(d.QTY * d.Unit_price) - SUM(d.Net_value)  AS discount,
        SUM(d.Net_value)                              AS net_sales
    FROM t_invoice_deils d
    JOIN t_invoice_sums h ON h.Invoice_no = d.Invoice_no
    WHERE h.BC = :bc
      AND h.Invoice_date BETWEEN :from AND :to
      AND (:store_id    IS NULL OR d.store_id      = :store_id)
      AND (:salesman_id IS NULL OR h.salesman_id   = :salesman_id)
      AND (:customer    IS NULL OR h.customer_code = :customer)
    GROUP BY d.Item_code
) s ON s.item_code = i.item_code
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        rd.item_code,
        SUM(rd.qty)        AS return_qty,
        SUM(rd.net_value)  AS return_value
    FROM t_sales_return_details rd
    JOIN t_sales_return_sums rs ON rs.return_no  = rd.return_no
    JOIN t_invoice_sums      h  ON h.Invoice_no  = rs.invoice_no
    WHERE rs.BC = :bc
      AND rs.return_date BETWEEN :from AND :to
      AND (:store_id    IS NULL OR rd.store_id     = :store_id)
      AND (:salesman_id IS NULL OR h.salesman_id   = :salesman_id)
      AND (:customer    IS NULL OR h.customer_code = :customer)
    GROUP BY rd.item_code
) r ON r.item_code = i.item_code
WHERE i.BC = :bc
  AND (s.item_code IS NOT NULL OR r.item_code IS NOT NULL)
  AND (:category IS NULL OR i.category_id = :category OR c.parent_id = :category)
  AND (:brand_id IS NULL OR i.brand_id = :brand_id)
  AND (:search   IS NULL OR i.item_code LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%')
                         OR i.item_description LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%'))
ORDER BY net_amount DESC, i.item_code;
